current_topic_pack_statement: 복구 후에는 4·12·20 mA 주입값과 0·50·100% 표시, engineering-unit scaling, alarm·trip 방향을 끝단까지 재검증하고 복구 상태를 기록한다.
current_registry_statement: After restoring a 4–20 mA loop, verify representative low, midpoint, and high output levels at the installed loop and receiving system, confirm the configured raw-to-engineering-unit scaling and applicable alarm/fault-current behavior, then document the returned-to-service state. The exact test points, alarm limits, trip logic, and acceptance tolerances are device- and application-specific; this is an end-to-end verification practice, not a universal trip-setting rule.
applicable_conditions: Repair testing details depend on loop and receiving equipment; cited Rockwell manual establishes configurable scaling only.
source_support_explanation: Rockwell documents raw-to-engineering-unit scaling, including a 4–20 mA example, but not the claimed post-repair end-to-end test/alarm/documentation procedure. The Emerson PDF could not be fetched.
review_notes: Full proposed procedure lacks inspectable direct evidence.

current_topic_pack_statement: PM 증가와 감쇠 증가·overshoot 감소, bandwidth 증가와 응답속도 향상의 관계는 dominant second-order와 유사한 조건에서 사용하는 근사적 설계 경향이다.
current_registry_statement: For a dominant-second-order-like closed loop, phase margin is an approximate proxy for damping (for the standard model, ζ is roughly PM/100 when PM is below about 70°); greater damping reduces second-order overshoot, while increasing the natural-frequency scale at fixed damping raises bandwidth and shortens the response time scale. These are model-dependent design trends, not universal laws for arbitrary systems.
proposed_statement: For an underdamped standard second-order response, increasing damping ratio reduces percent overshoot; at fixed damping ratio, increasing natural frequency raises the response frequency scale and generally shortens response time. Phase margin may serve as a qualitative damping proxy for suitably dominant second-order-like loops, but the relationship is model-dependent.
applicable_conditions: Model-dependent second-order/dominant-pole approximation; do not use PM/100 as a quantitative universal rule.
source_locator: PDF pp. 4–5, lines 39–41, 74–91; also MathWorks Design Requirements § Percent Overshoot, lines 94–100
source_support_explanation: MIT relates second-order response, damping ratio, bandwidth and crossover; MathWorks links percent overshoot to damping ratio. Evidence supports bounded second-order trends, not an exact general PM/100 mapping.
review_notes: Higher-order, delayed, nonminimum-phase or resonant loops may not follow this proxy.

current_topic_pack_statement: 접점 Chattering과 임계값 진동은 Debounce, On-delay·Off-delay, Hysteresis 및 지속시간 조건으로 억제하되, 보호응답 지연과 놓침 위험을 함께 검토해야 한다.
current_registry_statement: For sampled digital inputs, a debounce/filter or time qualification can reject short contact-bounce transitions, and hysteresis can prevent repeated switching when a noisy slowly varying signal crosses a threshold. These methods change detection behavior: short legitimate pulses may be missed and configured filters add response delay. Therefore thresholds and delays must be selected against both nuisance-transition behavior and the required protective response time; no universal setting is implied.
proposed_statement: Input filtering/time qualification can reject transitions shorter than the configured qualification interval, and comparator hysteresis can reduce repeated switching near a noisy threshold. Both alter detection behavior; select implementation and settings against the required response and valid pulse duration.
applicable_conditions: Siemens source is S7-1200 specific; digital filtering and analog comparator hysteresis are different implementations.
source_locator: Siemens S7-1200 V20, “The digital input filter works as follows,” lines 1089–1106; ADI article “Curing Comparator Instability with Hysteresis,” section “Variables affecting hysteresis”
source_support_explanation: Siemens describes filter accumulation and warns short transitions may not be detected. ADI source is a comparator hysteresis technical article. No universal setting is supported.
review_notes: Short valid pulses may be lost; device and protective response requirements govern settings.

current_topic_pack_statement: 교정용 기준기는 피교정기의 요구 불확도와 허용오차에 적합한 성능을 가져야 하며, 유효한 교정상태·식별·환경조건·보관·사용이력과 상위표준에 대한 추적성을 관리해야 한다.
current_registry_statement: A reference standard used to calibrate measurement equipment must be fit for the measurement's required accuracy/uncertainty and tolerance, with its identity, current calibration status, environmental conditions, handling/storage and use history controlled as required by the measurement program. Metrological traceability requires a documented calibration chain to stated references, with uncertainty contributions recorded at each link; no universal accuracy-ratio is implied.
proposed_statement: For a calibration result requiring metrological traceability, document an unbroken calibration chain to stated references and account for uncertainty contributions at each link. Select and maintain the reference standard to meet the measurement’s stated uncertainty/tolerance needs; no fixed accuracy ratio follows universally.
applicable_conditions: Fitness-for-purpose and control requirements depend on the measurement program and applicable quality system.
source_support_explanation: NIST defines traceability as an unbroken calibration chain with uncertainty contribution at each link. This source does not establish a universal accuracy ratio or guarantee suitability solely from traceability.
review_notes: Do not imply traceability alone guarantees adequate uncertainty.

current_topic_pack_statement: 권장 Authority는 제어 목적, 에너지, 펌프 여유, 운전범위와 허용 gain variation에 따라 달라지므로 하나의 고정 숫자를 모든 계통의 합격 기준으로 사용할 수 없다.
current_registry_statement: There is no single authority value that is a universal pass/fail criterion for all control-valve systems; acceptable allocation depends on the declared authority convention, operating range, controllability target, energy cost, pump/system limits, and process requirements.
proposed_statement: Valve authority conventions and definitions are not internationally standardized; therefore, compare values only after declaring the convention/system boundary. Acceptance is project- and operating-condition-specific, not a universal threshold.
applicable_conditions: Project specifications may impose a scoped threshold.
source_support_explanation: Valmet describes high/low authority in terms of relative system pressure losses and explicitly says the term is not standardized internationally.
review_notes: Does not prove no project or industry standard ever sets scoped limits.

current_topic_pack_statement: Valve Authority는 정의한 운전점과 시스템 경계에서 가변 압력강하 중 제어밸브가 담당하는 비율이다.
current_registry_statement: Valve authority is a dimensionless measure of the valve's share of a defined system pressure-drop budget at a stated operating condition. Because conventions differ (for example, valve drop relative to total variable circuit drop versus a valve drop normalized to a closed-valve condition), the formula and system boundary must be declared before comparing values.
proposed_statement: Valve authority describes the control valve’s share of a stated system pressure-drop basis at an operating condition. Since conventions are not internationally standardized, state the equation and system boundary before comparing authority values.
applicable_conditions: The exact convention and operating point must be declared.
source_support_explanation: Valmet supports pressure-drop-share meaning and lack of international standardization. Alternate closed-valve-normalized formula in the current claim was not established by the opened page.
review_notes: Avoid asserting a specific alternate formula without its own source.

current_topic_pack_statement: 최종 characteristic selection은 manufacturer inherent curve와 예상 pump·system pressure model을 결합하여 minimum·normal·maximum operating point의 installed curve를 검토한다.
current_registry_statement: Control-valve characteristic selection should evaluate the installed relationship, not only the manufacturer's inherent curve: the installed curve depends on the system pressure conditions, including pump head and piping/equipment losses. An installed-flow/gain analysis can use minimum and maximum design-flow cases and the corresponding upstream/downstream pressures; include the normal operating case when it is part of the specified operating envelope. This is an engineering selection method, not a universal requirement for one particular calculation tool or acceptance threshold.
proposed_statement: For a specified control-valve operating envelope, assess the installed flow characteristic using the relevant valve and system pressure conditions; the inherent curve alone does not describe installed performance. Evaluate the operating cases needed by the project’s envelope and control objective.
applicable_conditions: Case selection follows project operating envelope; no universal min/normal/max calculation mandate.
source_locator: PDF p. 113, glossary “Inherent Valve Gain” / “Installed Characteristic,” lines 9596–9602; Valmet installed performance §2.1 lines 88–91
source_support_explanation: Emerson distinguishes constant-pressure-drop inherent gain from installed characteristic. Valmet describes installed prediction with a pipeline model.
review_notes: Emerson sourcebook is refinery-oriented; do not generalize its application examples.

current_topic_pack_statement: Positioner calibration·diagnostic 작업에서는 조정 전 상태(as-found)와 조정·검증 후 상태(as-left)를 구분해 기록한다. Fisher DVC6200 문서는 calibration 전 signature 진단으로 as-found data를 확보할 수 있다고 설명하고, NIST는 calibration report에 pre/post calibration data를 포함할 것을 권고한다. 현재·압력·travel·hysteresis 항목과 acceptance 기준은 기기 및 적용 절차에 맞추며 보편적 고정 record set이라고 단정하지 않는다.
current_registry_statement: For positioner calibration or diagnostic work, distinguish and retain the as-found condition before adjustment from the as-left condition after adjustment/verification. Emerson describes capturing DVC6200 as-found data with a valve-signature diagnostic before calibration; NIST recommends pre- and post-calibration accuracy/precision data in calibration reports. The detailed fields and acceptance limits depend on the device and governing procedure; no universal fixed record set is asserted.
proposed_statement: When calibration work requires a before/after comparison, retain the pre-adjustment condition and post-adjustment verification results under the governing procedure. A DVC6200 valve-signature test is one manufacturer-specific means of capturing as-found data.
applicable_conditions: DVC6200 procedure is product-specific; detailed records follow governing work procedure.
source_support_explanation: Emerson directs a DVC6200 user to capture as-found data with a pre-calibration signature test. This passage does not establish a universal complete as-left record set.
review_notes: NIST recommended calibration interval URL does not establish pre/post record requirements.

current_topic_pack_statement: 루프 이득과 대역폭 증가는 추종성과 저주파 외란 억제를 개선할 수 있다. 그러나 시간지연, 우반평면 영점 및 미모델 고주파 동특성은 달성 가능한 대역폭을 제한하고 위상여유와 강인 안정성을 저하시킬 수 있다. 높은 대역폭은 센서 잡음 전달과 제어입력을 증가시킬 수 있으며, 액추에이터 포화는 선형 위상여유의 직접 원인이라기보다 비선형 성능 저하와 적분 windup을 유발할 수 있다.
current_registry_statement: 루프 대역폭 증가는 조건에 따라 추종과 외란응답을 빠르게 할 수 있지만 성능과 안정여유의 절충이 필요하다. 시간지연은 위상을 추가로 낮춰 대역폭과 폐루프 안정성을 제한한다. 폐루프 설계에서는 제어 대역 밖의 측정잡음 민감도와 미모델 동특성도 함께 제한해야 하며, 높은 대역폭을 무조건 목표로 삼지 않는다.
proposed_statement: Control bandwidth is selected as a design tradeoff: process delay adds phase lag and limits achievable bandwidth, while feedback gain/bandwidth must be balanced against stability margin, sensor-noise amplification, and model uncertainty. The suitable bandwidth depends on the loop and its requirements.
applicable_conditions: Control-design trend, not a guarantee that increasing bandwidth improves all response measures.
source_locator: “Control of Processes with Delays,” lines 21–24; MathWorks Modeling Uncertainty lines 17–20
source_support_explanation: MathWorks directly states delays limit control bandwidth and affect closed-loop stability; uncertainty page explains balancing disturbance rejection against noise/model uncertainty.
review_notes: Target margins and bandwidth are system-specific.

current_topic_pack_statement: 정의된 LOPA scenario에서 요구 위험감소 비율이 1 이하이면 해당 빈도 기준만으로는 추가 SIF 위험감소 요구가 발생하지 않는다. 다만 다른 scenario와 ALARP에 따른 추가 조치 검토는 별개다.
current_registry_statement: 정의된 LOPA scenario에서 required RRF가 1 이하이면 해당 빈도 기준만으로는 추가 SIF 요구가 발생하지 않으나, 다른 scenario와 ALARP 검토는 별개다.
source_locator: Opened CCPS LOPA Data landing page; no clause/locator states the RRF ≤ 1 decision rule.
source_support_explanation: The cited page is a resource landing page and does not substantiate this specific LOPA decision rule. A primary methodology clause was not inspected.
review_notes: LOPA conventions and assumptions must be documented; arithmetic interpretation alone is insufficient.

current_topic_pack_statement: Batch Genealogy는 원자재 Lot, 설비, Recipe·Version, 작업·공정조건, 품질결과와 완제품 Lot의 관계를 시간과 식별자로 연결한다.
current_registry_statement: Manufacturing genealogy can link consumed or produced material lots and sublots to equipment, batch/recipe and execution records, process conditions, and quality results so that product history can be traced for analysis or recall. ISA-95 models material lots and their assembly/trace relationships, while ISA-88 batch records may include recipe execution, equipment, alarms and other batch-relevant information. Complete genealogy is not automatic: the site must capture, identify, version, retain and correlate the required records across its systems.
proposed_statement: A manufacturing information model can represent identified material lots and sublots, their assembly relationships, and batch production records for retrieval and analysis. The actual genealogy and context available depend on the records and links an implementation captures.
applicable_conditions: ISA-95/ISA-88 sources are data models/reference models; specific properties and implementation capture may be optional.
source_support_explanation: OPC UA ISA-95 defines material lots and optional assembly/test/attribute references. ISA-88.00.04 defines a reference model for batch production records. Neither guarantees automatic complete genealogy.
review_notes: Do not claim all equipment, conditions, quality, or recall data are always recorded.

current_topic_pack_statement: 운영 중에는 입력 품질, Missing, Range, Latency, Prediction 분포, 성능, False Alarm, 사용자 조치와 System Health를 지속 Monitoring한다.
current_registry_statement: 운영 중 AI는 사전평가와 운영환경 간의 성능·입력/출력 분포 차이, 데이터·센서 품질, 시스템 기능과 이상을 모니터링하고 실제 정답이 확보되면 성능을 재평가한다. 감시 항목·임계치·조치는 위험과 배포 맥락에 맞게 정하고, 모든 시스템에 동일한 고정 metric 목록이 적용되는 것은 아니다.
proposed_statement: Test AI systems before deployment and regularly during operation; select risk-relevant measures for functionality and trustworthiness in the deployment context, and document their limits. The RMF does not prescribe one fixed metric list or threshold for all systems.
applicable_conditions: Monitoring measures and thresholds depend on risk and deployment context.
source_locator: AI RMF Core §5.3 Measure, lines 192–194; Measure Playbook line 921 and surrounding guidance
source_support_explanation: NIST calls for predeployment and regular operational testing, and risk measurement/documentation. It does not require a fixed set of drift, sensor, latency, or ground-truth metrics.
review_notes: Ground-truth-driven performance reassessment timing is not specified by cited lines.

current_topic_pack_statement: Training Data는 정상·고장·운전모드·제품·계절·정비상태와 Sensor 품질을 대표해야 하며 수집 편향과 Label 품질을 기록해야 한다.
current_registry_statement: 학습·평가 자료는 의도된 설비·운전·배포 맥락에 적합하고 그 맥락을 대표하는지 점검해야 한다. 정상/고장 상태, 운전모드, 제품, 계절, 정비상태, 센서 품질 등은 적용 분야에서 대표성에 영향을 주는 후보 차원이지 모든 프로젝트의 고정 필수목록은 아니다. 자료 선택·수집 맥락, 데이터 품질, ground-truth/label의 한계와 편향을 기록한다.
proposed_statement: Assess whether training and evaluation data adequately reflect the intended use and deployment context, and document material gaps, quality limits, and known bias. Choose relevant coverage dimensions for the application; no single checklist applies to every project.
applicable_conditions: The directly cited representativeness passage specifically addresses human-subject evaluation data; industrial data dimensions remain context-specific examples.
source_support_explanation: NIST says human-subject evaluations should represent the relevant population and warns non-representative data can lead to inaccurate assessment or harm. Broad extension to every industrial training dataset should remain bounded.
review_notes: Normal/fault/mode/product/season/maintenance dimensions are examples, not universal required strata.

current_topic_pack_statement: DC 계장 전원은 power-supply capacity, distribution voltage drop, fuse/branch selectivity, common return impedance와 load transient를 함께 검토해야 한다.
current_registry_statement: DC instrumentation power distribution should be checked against the selected supply's capacity and load-step behavior, conductor voltage drop, branch protection/selectivity, and shared-return impedance effects on signal reference; the required checks and corrective measures depend on the connected loads, wiring, and protection design.
source_locator: Opened NI field wiring/noise page; exact locator for complete distribution checklist not established. Siemens SITOP PDF fetch failed due size.
source_support_explanation: Available opened NI pages relate to analog signal wiring/noise and programmable-source cable loss, not the full combined claim about capacity, load steps, protection selectivity and shared-return impedance.
review_notes: Claim bundles distinct checks that need separate source grounding.

current_topic_pack_statement: 현장 이득은 Nyquist 임계경계에서 여유를 두고 운전점, 모델 오차, 지연, 잡음과 포화를 검증한다.
current_registry_statement: For a specified negative-feedback loop, the Nyquist stability margin is assessed from the loop transfer around the -1 critical point; practical robustness review should linearize at relevant operating points and check gain, phase, and delay margins, while representing model uncertainty and sensor-noise tradeoffs explicitly. These linear margins do not certify behavior after actuator saturation: saturation is a nonlinear operating condition and must be assessed separately with actuator limits represented, including recovery or anti-windup behavior where applicable. Margin targets and the operating envelope are system-specific, not universal numeric rules.
proposed_statement: Classical gain, phase, and delay margins characterize a specified linearized negative-feedback model. They do not by themselves establish performance under actuator saturation; assess relevant nonlinear actuator limits separately when they occur in the operating envelope. Margin targets and operating cases are application-specific.
applicable_conditions: Linearized loop assumptions apply; saturation requires separate nonlinear consideration.
source_locator: allmargin description lines 29–34; Modeling Uncertainty lines 17–20; Anti-Windup example lines 13–19
source_support_explanation: MathWorks documents classical margins for negative feedback, balancing noise/model uncertainty, and saturation-related integrator windup. It supports the bounded distinction between linear margins and saturation behavior.
review_notes: Anti-windup is one method, not a universal requirement; `allmargin` is not itself a Nyquist-plot definition.

current_topic_pack_statement: Hamamatsu가 제시한 Direct ToF 수광 구성에서는 송신 파장 λ₀에 중심을 둔 band-pass filter를 사용해 수광부에 들어오는 배경광을 줄인다. 이는 해당 Direct ToF 구성의 필터 예이며, 모든 광학 센서가 같은 필터나 억제기법을 사용해야 한다는 뜻은 아니다.
current_registry_statement: In Hamamatsu’s described pulsed direct-ToF receiver, band-pass filters centered on the transmitted wavelength λ0 are used to reduce background light. This verifies a filter implementation example, not a universal requirement or the only ambient-light mitigation for optical sensors.
source_locator: Opened page lines 126–128, 270–286, 330–331 discuss ToF/interferometry; page search for “band-pass” and “filter” found no matching text.
source_support_explanation: Cited page does not verify the claimed filter implementation. In any case, a manufacturer-specific filter example is non-core for general scoring under the eligibility policy.
review_notes: Keep only as unscored vendor-specific context if a direct Hamamatsu source is found.

current_topic_pack_statement: RTD는 기준온도계와 안정된 온도원을 사용하여 다점교정하며, 센서 허용오차, 회로, 배선, 자기발열과 설치오차를 측정불확도에 반영한다.
current_registry_statement: When RTD calibration or range characterization is required, compare the assembled sensor/measurement chain with a traceable reference thermometer in a sufficiently stable, well-characterized temperature source at points spanning the intended range. The uncertainty budget should include relevant reference/source/readout contributions and RTD/application effects such as self-heating, immersion/thermal contact, lead resistance and repeatability or stability. Exact points, corrections and uncertainty terms depend on range, wiring, sensor design and calibration method; a blanket requirement for the same number of points in every application is not implied.
proposed_statement: For RTD calibration, characterize the sensor and readout over the required range using a suitable temperature source and reference. Include relevant uncertainty and use-condition effects—such as self-heating and immersion—according to sensor, wiring, medium, and method; select points to meet the calibration objective.
applicable_conditions: Calibration point count, range, wiring, sensor, medium and method are application-dependent.
source_support_explanation: The guide discusses self-heating dependence on current/medium, immersion error, and illustrative uncertainty budgets that may be incomplete. Supports a conditional uncertainty/installation-effects statement, not a fixed universal checklist or point count.
review_notes: Lead resistance/repeatability terms are relevant when applicable, not mandatory in every budget.

current_topic_pack_statement: lead·lag·PID 보상은 목표 crossover, PM, 저주파 이득과 잡음 조건을 함께 고려하고, 적용 전 운전점·시간지연·포화·rate limit·deadband·모델 오차를 검증한다.
current_registry_statement: Loop-shaping a lead/lag or PID compensator involves application-specific choices of crossover/bandwidth, stability margins, low-frequency gain for tracking/disturbance rejection, and high-frequency roll-off for noise and model uncertainty. Before deployment, check whether the linear design remains acceptable over relevant operating points and nonidealities such as process delay, actuator saturation/rate limits, valve deadband and model error; linear Bode margins alone do not represent all nonlinear implementation behavior. The target values and validation tests depend on the loop's operating envelope and risk/performance requirements.
proposed_statement: Compensator tuning may use open-loop frequency response to meet bandwidth and gain/phase-margin specifications; closed-loop prefilter tuning can target tracking, disturbance rejection and noise rejection. Model dead time explicitly because it adds phase shift and limits control bandwidth and closed-loop stability.
applicable_conditions: Model and delay conditions apply; source does not establish the broader commissioning checklist.
source_locator: Tuning Methods lines 18–28; Analyze Control Systems with Delays lines 21–23.
source_support_explanation: MathWorks directly supports frequency response, bandwidth, gain/phase margin, noise rejection, and delay-induced phase/bandwidth/stability limits.
review_notes: Content review only; existing scoring holds remain unchanged.

current_topic_pack_statement: Commissioning은 안전조건과 승인된 절차 아래 Energization, 정적점검, Loop·기능시험, 단계별 기동, Tuning, 부하시험과 안정화 순으로 수행한다.
current_registry_statement: Commissioning은 안전조건과 승인된 절차 아래 Energization, 정적점검, Loop·기능시험, 단계별 기동, Tuning, 부하시험과 안정화 순으로 수행한다.
proposed_statement: Commissioning should follow controlled, current site procedures; changes to procedures should be documented and subject to company change control.
applicable_conditions: HSE guidance; commissioning sequence depends on site hazards and approved procedures.
source_locator: Operating procedures lines 105–112; Commissioning procedures section begins line 113.
source_support_explanation: HSE supports controlled/current procedures and controlled changes; it does not establish the row’s universal fixed sequence.
review_notes: Content review only; existing scoring holds remain unchanged.

current_topic_pack_statement: Authority가 낮으면 밸브 travel 변화가 실제 유량 변화로 전달되는 관계가 고유 특성에서 크게 왜곡될 수 있으며 왜곡의 방향과 크기는 고유 특성 및 시스템 저항에 따라 달라진다.
current_registry_statement: When the valve takes a small share of the relevant system pressure drop, changes in other system losses can strongly affect its available Δp and installed flow curve; low authority can therefore increase distortion from the inherent curve, but magnitude and shape depend on trim and system conditions.
proposed_statement: The installed flow characteristic can differ from the inherent valve characteristic because piping pressure loss varies with flow and changes the pressure drop across the valve. The resulting shape depends on the valve characteristic and system conditions.
applicable_conditions: Magnitude and direction depend on system curve and valve characteristic; no universal authority threshold is implied.
source_locator: Installed-performance lines 105–115; authority discussion lines 139 onward.

current_registry_statement: For a finite-dimensional LTI plant with observer-based state feedback, the nominal closed-loop characteristic polynomial factors into the state-feedback and observer-error factors, so their gains can be designed separately. Arbitrary pole assignment requires controllability of (A,B) and observability of (A,C); asymptotic stabilization requires (A,B) stabilizable and (A,C) detectable. Detectability alone does not guarantee that a stabilizing state-feedback gain exists.

current_registry_statement: For a feasible continuous-time tracking problem, augmenting the controller with the integral of constant-reference output error supplies an integrator internal model. Constant-disturbance rejection likewise depends on disturbance injection location and closed-loop feasibility; it is not unconditional.
